recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-25272; replacement work should be handled through FHIR-53122 in the FHIR Extension Pack or through a future final core decision if FHIR-54123 advances.
issue_request: FHIR-25272 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request raised against R4 and applied for R5, requesting a core ValueSet.scope backbone element with focus, inclusionCriteria, exclusionCriteria, and modelContext string subelements based on VSD scope definitions.
initial_application: No git commit in the current checkout explicitly names FHIR-25272. The requested scope structure appears to have been applied implicitly by 054eabf3116825c0f65107fedff6668447bf43a1 during R5 VSD profile work, after an earlier reverted attempt, adding ValueSet.scope and the requested subelements to source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml. Later R5 changes under FHIR-34171/FHIR-35988/FHIR-35989 narrowed the design by tying scope to ValueSet.description and removing scope.focus.
additional_context: FHIR-34171 explicitly describes itself as a reversal of FHIR-25272 because implementers were using ValueSet.description for the VSD scope concept; FHIR-34171, FHIR-35988, and FHIR-35989 already have audit commits on the combined branch. The 2025 Terminology Infrastructure minutes approved moving trial-use valueSet.scope out of core for R6 and into the extension pack; FHIR-53122 tracks that FHIR-extensions work, while FHIR-54123 remains Triaged and not final.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini keeps ValueSet active, but current source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml no longer contains ValueSet.scope or the requested subelements because 40306e5cd9c1b1e3eb6f115de16a8da3aa13a351 removed the trial-use scope structure and related notes for R6 terminology cleanup. Re-adding the core element would contradict later applied source history and related final decisions.
